text:
Nina: Quick sync  we need a small experiment for the pricing estimator + FAQ refresh. Goal: fewer CS tickets about estimates, better mid-funnel routing to webinar / AE. Plan to deploy A/B calc next week. Any blockers?

Omar: No blockers. Proposal: test two tier namings alongside the calc. Variant A: Starter / Growth / Scale. Variant B: Launch / Momentum / Enterprise. See if naming affects clicks to 'Compare plans'.

Rhea: For the UI I suggest compact mode for embeds. Keep CTA under the summary and add tiny microcopy: "Illustrative estimate don't bind a contract". Also add a small tooltip on EU pages about data residency.

Carlos: Copy ideas: CTA copy A: 'Estimate monthly' CTA B: 'Commit to save'. Also microcopy under total: 'Includes estimated reserved discount' vs 'Illustrative discount applied'. We'll track which microcopy reduces 'how do you calculate' questions.

Mika: Routing thresholds suggestion: projected_monthly >= 7500 -> high_value (AE ping + slack alert #sales-highvalue); 2000-7499 -> webinar_invite; <2000 -> nurture. Use zapier/hubspot webhook. Tagging ops-bot to create rule.

ops-bot: Routing rule created: name=estimator_routes_v2, conditions: projected_monthly >= 7500 -> tag:high_value; 2000-7499 -> tag:webinar_invite; <2000 -> tag:nurture. webhook_url=https://hooks.redwood.ai/lead-route/id_77

Nina: Great. Analytics events: estimator_open, estimator_submit, estimated_monthly, tier_variant, cta_copy, faq_help_click. Add a boolean event 'webinar_cta_shown'.

Omar: Optimizely setup: 50/50 for tier naming, 40/60 for CTA copy (favor control), factorial for microcopy under total (2x). Early stop: min 800 calc submits OR p<0.01. Success metric: webinar_signup_rate for mid tier, AE_contacted for high_value.

Rhea: FAQ accordion copy (draft): "How is my estimate calculated?" -> "We multiply your inputs (tokens/sec, avg context length) by model token cost, add a small SLO buffer, and apply illustrative volume discounts. Use this to plan capacity, not as billing. See /docs/pricing-estimates."

Carlos: I'll wire the copy into the modal and add small 'Saving tips' when estimated_monthly > 1200 (bullets: batch, KV cache, lower precision). Link to Optimize docs.

Ethan: UX note: show webinar CTA only after user clicks 'See breakdown' OR when estimated_monthly >= 2500, whichever comes first. Keeps it subtle.

Nina: Locking next steps: Omar sets up Optimizely variants; ops-bot keeps routing rule live; Carlos + Rhea finalize copy and send to staging; Mika will draft sales handoff (sample HubSpot lists + Slack alert format). Quick 15m tomorrow 11:00am PT to confirm. :rocket:
